en: {fb:0980}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}In Gruche, the capital of the Kingdom of Fangam, I found someone who'd make a perfect-o hero!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}Her name is Ashe Bradarik. Get this, she's the princess of Fangam!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}She's cheerful and lively, and great at martial arts, but apparently she's run away from home, so this might be our chance to meet her!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}Oh... Anyway, she seems perfect for a hero. What do you think of her, Angel?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0A80}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}In Nova, in the Kingdom of Kimbalt, I found someone who'd make a perfect-o hero!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}Her name is Beasia Gray. She's a martial artist who's famous around there, and the only girl at the Gray-style dojo.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}She's still new as a martial artist, but she's incredibly strong. Ordinary martial artists are no match for her.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}She says she wants to train even more, so I think she's just the kind of hero you were talking about, Angel. What do you think?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0B80}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}In Trust, in the Kanoa Nation, I found someone who'd make a perfect-o hero!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}She's a dancer who calls herself Nasadia, and nobody knows anything about her past. She's a woman wrapped in mystery.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}But from what I hear, she's not just a dancer: she's a master with the whip. They say she even seems used to fighting.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}There's a lot I don't know about her, but I get the feeling she'd make a perfect hero. What do you think, Angel?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0C80}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}In Omron, in Kvaal, I found someone who'd make a perfect-o hero!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}Her name is Tia Tangeri. She's just a completely ordinary girl.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}But what makes her right for a hero is how earnest she is, and how pure her heart is. And besides that, I get the feeling she's hiding some mysterious power...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}I sense something in her. A power that's perfect for a hero... What do you think, Angel?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}I have discovered {name:0180}-sama. From the look of things, if you do not go to see them now, they may never come back.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
We can no longer sense {name:0180}-sama.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{spk:0080}{n}Angel! I have found {name:0180}-sama, who was missing.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{e0:1E00}{spk:0080}{n}Angel, I have found a hero candidate.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0180}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}I wish to inform you that I have found a promising hero in Joost, in the Kingdom of Hebron.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}His name is Sievas Volkgang, a nobleman of the kingdom.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}He gives a somewhat flashy impression, but he is widely said to be outstanding with a sword.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}I believe he would make a fine hero... What do you think, Angel?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0280}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}I wish to inform you that I have found a promising hero in Voras, the capital of the Kingdom of Hebron.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}His name is Reiv Vincelras, and he serves as commander of the kingdom's knights.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}He has an air that keeps people at a distance, but no one can match him with a sword, and everyone seems to hold him in high regard.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}I believe he would make a fine hero... What do you think, Angel?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0380}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}I wish to inform you that I have found a promising hero in Niesen, in the Kingdom of Kimbalt.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}His name is Griffin, and at present he is the chief of a band of thieves.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}He is a man of action and outstanding with a sword, and his comrades trust him deeply.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}I believe he would make a fine hero... What do you think, Angel?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0480}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}I wish to inform you that I have found someone with the potential to be a hero in Fedeco, in the Kanoa Nation.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}His name is Felimi MacDill, and he travels as a wandering bard.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}He loves nature and longs for peace, and seems to dislike conflict, but he appears to be quite skilled with a bow.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}I believe he would make a fine hero... What do you think, Angel?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0580}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}I wish to inform you that I have found a promising hero in Brun, in the Esparda Empire.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}His name is Dian Alvis, a doctor of good repute in those parts.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}However, there are rumors that he secretly hunts down villains, perhaps out of a very strong sense of justice.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}I believe he would make a fine hero... What do you think, Angel?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0680}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}I wish to inform you that I have found someone with the potential to be a hero in Garf, in Kvaal.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}His name is Yaruru Willing, and he is a boy of only twelve.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}Even so, he is quite good with a boomerang, and for some reason he lives with a sacred beast. I do not know why...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}I believe he would make a fine hero... What do you think, Angel?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0780}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}I wish to inform you that I have found a promising hero in Larousse, in the Duminas Empire.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}His name is Ryudral Algrane, and people call him "the Dragon's Messenger."{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}I do not know the reason, but he was raised by dragons, and so he has the ability to speak with them. {fb:0880}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}I wish to inform you that I have found a promising hero in Tambour, in Kvaal.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}She is a woman named Fiana Ecliya, a bounty hunter famous in Tambour.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}Her swordsmanship is superb; she is said to stand head and shoulders above other swordsmen.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}I believe she would make a fine hero...
